rules.start: run the dry run first: <actionCommand> --dry-run, and start for real only when the dry run says 'checks passed'. The ticket CLI refuses a ticket it may not start, and a refusal starts nothing.
rules.gate: the queue gates the head and records it, so a head is never gated twice. A head whose builder check does not name it is not gated.
rules.fix: the queue reads the gate's own report and sends it to the thread that built the pull request.
